flows.description: Produce representative telemetry while deliberately blocking the main actor for a bounded interval; verify mailbox depth and latest convergence.
flows.release_boundary: after producer stop and presentation bridge stop

flows.description: Open gauge screen, stabilize, navigate away/minimize/occlude, and measure draw callbacks/resource ownership.
flows.release_boundary: after scene detach and scheduler quiescence

flows.description: Repeat gauge screen open/close at least 100 deterministic iterations.
flows.release_boundary: after each close and final autorelease drain

flows.description: Open, use, close, and switch projects repeatedly with memory and telemetry active.
Start, stream, cancel, fail, and exit child processes repeatedly with large stdout/stderr fixtures.
flows.release_boundary: supervisor reports reaped and readers closed

flows.description: Populate/search/update/export a bounded large corpus across multiple project identities.
flows.release_boundary: queries complete, caches purge, project closes

flows.description: Inject crash/failure at every continuity transition and prove eventual single-successor resume.
Terminate and relaunch during active project, memory write, and rollover states.
